blurb: Guests parasail over Lake of The Ozarks with flights ranging from 1 to 4 miles depending on the number of riders and flight type. No experience or swimming ability is required. Life jackets are provided and takeoffs and landings are from the boat.
extraNote: Observers may come on the boat if space is available, parasailers get first priority · Located at Paradise Marina and Watersports at the 0 Mile Marker, next to the Bagnell Dam.
